description: This PHP source file defines the 'ViewQuick' class, which extends 'ViewDetail' to implement a quick view functionality in the SuiteCRM application. It sets display options to hide various UI components and outputs JSON data containing record details.

classes.name: ViewQuick
classes.description: A class extending ViewDetail to provide a quick view feature with tailored display options and JSON output.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes display options to hide subpanels, titles, headers, footers, and JavaScript for the quick view.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Displays the quick view, ensuring a record ID exists, then outputs JSON with title, URL, and HTML content of the record.
